facts.fact: SCSS is not cut: the current SCSS rate is 8.2% per annum
facts.quote: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme Account (SCSS) Rate of Interest: 8.2% per annum
facts.note: India Post savings page shows 'Last Updated On: 19.10.2026'.

facts.fact: Rates for 1 Oct - 31 Dec 2026 (Q3 FY 2026-27) were set by DEA's Office Memorandum dated 30.09.2026
facts.quote: Revision of interest rates for Small Savings Schemes for Q3 2026-27 30.09.2026

facts.fact: The NSI rate table shows SCSS at 8.2% up to 30.09.2026 (covering Jul-Sep 2026, Q2)
facts.note: On 28 Oct 2026 the NSI table had no Oct-Dec 2026 row yet.

facts.fact: The 30.09.2026 OM keeps all small savings rates for Oct-Dec 2026 (Q3 FY 2026-27) unchanged from Q2, so SCSS stays at 8.2%
facts.note: Read by OCR from the scanned OM (DEA Budget Division, F.No.1/4/2019-NS dated 30.09.2026); OCR prints '1st' as '1%' and '31st' as '31°'. The Q2 rate (SCSS 8.2%) is from the NSI table and India Post page; the Q3 value is derived from 'unchanged'.
facts.quote: The rates of interest on various Small Savings Schemes for the third quarter of FY 2026-27 starting from 1% October, 2026 and ending on 31° December, 2026 shall remain unchanged from those notified for the second quarter

facts.fact: 7.4% is the Post Office Monthly Income Scheme (MIS) rate, not the SCSS rate
facts.quote: Post Office Monthly Income Scheme Account (MIS) Rate of Interest: 7.4% per annum payable monthly

summary: SCSS 8.2% (India Post current page; NSI to 30.09.2026) and MIS 7.4% confirmed; DEA Q3 OM dated 30.09.2026 confirmed; 'unchanged' only in the scanned OM (manual). Audit 28 Oct 2026: the DEA OM of 30.09.2026 is now read by OCR and says Q3 rates remain unchanged from Q2.
